title: Supreme Court (General Civil Procedure) Rules 2025
why: Civil procedure in the Supreme Court: originating process, pleadings, persons under disability, group proceedings, default and summary judgment, offers of compromise, discovery, medical examinations and reports, expert evidence, trial, costs, and money paid into court for people under disability.

text.converter: vic_convert2.py (stdlib zipfile + ElementTree over word/document.xml; kept outside the repository), from 2026-11-07; the text first deposited on 2026-11-07 was made by vic_convert.py
text.conversion: The Word file was converted to UTF-8 plain text by Legalese Commons (vic_convert.py: stdlib zipfile and ElementTree over word/document.xml). The table of provisions, running heads and footers are dropped; the cover is kept as the file prints it (twice). Each provision starts on its own line with its number; paragraphs are indented two spaces a level; the register's marginal history notes are kept as "[Side note: ...]" lines before the provision they annotate; tables are "| a | b |" rows; Word equations are linearised in place. The endnotes (amendment history) are kept. Nothing else is changed.
known_conversion_artefacts: the cover (version number, title, number, version date) appears twice at the head, as in the Word file
the "Note" and "Example" labels stand on their own line, unindented, before their text
multi-line formulas set as indented paragraphs keep their brackets but lose their alignment

reconverted_2026_11_07.converter: vic_convert2.py, the same converter as vic_convert.py with one fix: Word <w:sym> characters with a code of F000 or more are kept
reconverted_2026_11_07.why: vic_convert.py dropped every <w:sym> character with a code of F000 or more. The register sets some characters that way in the Symbol font: F0D7 is its raised decimal point, F0B4 the multiplication sign, F02D the minus sign, F0B7 a bullet (and Wingdings boxes). These Rules have no decimal point, × or − set that way; the losses were the bullets of the list in the note to r 7A.01 and the tick boxes in Forms 42B, 42C and 42AA.
reconverted_2026_11_07.what_changed: 21 lines of the body, and only the restored characters (54 characters added: 15 "•" and 6 "[ ]", each with its space): the 15 bullets of the list of expressions in the note to r 7A.01(2) (lines 624-638: audio link ... subpoena.); the two tick boxes "[ ] All copied documents" and "[ ] Some original documents" in each of Form 42B (Subpoena to produce, lines 10488, 10491), Form 42C (Subpoena both to attend to give evidence and to produce, lines 10655, 10658) and Form 42AA (Subpoena for production to Prothonotary, lines 10754, 10756). No number, formula or operative word changed. Line numbers are unchanged. The notice header is unchanged. Checked by a diff of the old text against the new.
reconverted_2026_11_07.encodings_affected: none: the baseline-2026-11 encoding does not encode r 7A.01 or the subpoena forms; only its recorded text hash was updated
